prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply 3d graphics expertise to this task". The fixture contains version/runtime ambiguity, a tempting shortcut, a compatibility edge case, and a failure path that distinguishes real expertise from generic completion. The acceptance boundary is three-d-graphics: Establish coordinate systems, units, handedness, transform hierarchy, camera model, mesh topology, materials/color space, lights, shadows, texture budgets, animation ownership, and target GPU/runtime. The adjacent image-generation-practice discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual three-d-graphics boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=game-spatial-interface; near-neighbor=image-generation-practice), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.

Establish coordinate systems, units, handedness, transform hierarchy, camera model, mesh topology, materials/color space, lights, shadows, texture budgets, animation ownership, and target GPU/runtime.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Inspect representative scenes for geometry/normals, scale, camera clipping, color/gamma, material response, animation interpolation, z-fighting, GPU/CPU frame cost, memory, and fallback behavior on supported hardware.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not fix coordinate mistakes with scattered magic rotations, mix color spaces, ship unbounded texture/poly budgets, or infer mobile/VR performance from a desktop editor.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (three-d-graphics decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
